rules: Two outputs of one task are shown side by side as A and B. The collector assigns the sides at random once, persists them with the assignment, and returns the same assignment and sides after a restart.
The blind payload carries the case brief, its TL;DR and the two previews or live sites only. Producer, model, source, prior rating and score are never shown.
The reviewer chooses A, B, tie or skip, with an optional reason and feedback tags. A skip is recorded as an abstention, not a tie or a loss.
A repeated identical vote is idempotent; a different vote on the same assignment is refused. Corrections and retractions are recorded only in the SDK sidecar; collector votes are never rewritten.
Reviewer names are self-declared collector identities, not authenticated accounts.
